messages:
june (AE): Heads-up: Prospect Helio wants a minimal compliance packet for their POC — SOC2 artifact snippets (data retention + encryption), a signed pen-test confirmation letter, and a temporary presigned upload for their scanner output. Need to confirm timeline and no surprise fees.
omar (Sales-Eng): Clarify: they want the artifacts before kickoff or just available during POC?
june (AE): They want delivery ahead of kickoff this Friday.
rachel (Security): We can prepare redacted SOC2 excerpts focused on 'encryption at rest' and 'change management'. Will include a short README explaining redactions.
taylor (Legal): For the pen-test confirmation we use the standard attestation template. We need the vendor name, test completion date, and whether Helio requires a notarized or witnessed copy.
june (AE): Vendor: WhiteHat Partners. Completed 2025-03-05. No notarization requested in email.
sam (Infra): Staging IPs for the scan: 35.199.80.0/24 and 3.14.72.128/26. If they run unauthenticated scans it's fine; for authenticated scans we issue a short-lived service account with scope-limited creds.
omar (Sales-Eng): Presigned link TTL? Helio ops asked for 48h to ingest results.
sam (Infra): Default presign TTL is 3600s. We can do 172800s (48h) but ops must approve since it increases S3 exposure window.
rachel (Security): Any logs we share must have customer IPs redacted and tokens removed. I will draft a redaction checklist and run quick scans to verify.
taylor (Legal): No fee for standard attestation for ongoing POCs. Charge applies if they request contract amendments or additional liability terms.
dataroom-bot: Action created: presign-request-5591. Owner: sam. ETA: 2025-03-07 09:00 UTC.
sam (Infra): I'll create the presigned link Friday 09:00 UTC set to 48h, and reserve scan slots Fri-Sun 08:00-16:00 PT.
june (AE): Can we get the attestation + SOC2 excerpt ready by Thursday EOD so I can review before sending?
rachel (Security): Yes — SOC2 excerpt + redaction notes Thursday EOD.
taylor (Legal): I'll prepare signed pen-test confirmation by Friday morning.
omar (Sales-Eng): I'll add a small 'what's redacted' doc in the proofpack and a contact for follow-up.
june (AE): Thanks team. If Helio pushes for full report, escalate to Legal and Security; we'll avoid sending full report unless absolutely required.
dataroom-bot: presign-request-5591 completed. URL: https://presigns.redwood.example/5591-helio (expires in 48h).
june (AE): Sent to Helio ops. Closing thread unless blockers. :thumbsup:
